records.text: Owens said Lyle Reams's prior indictment apparently did not prevent Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta from forming Desert Spirit Tek with Lyle and Shelly Reams in 2017.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyways, this background I'm telling you about Lyle (Lyle Reams) because it was apparently not a bar to entry for Lori (Lori Frantzve) and Larry (Larry Guinta) to pursue a business with Lyle (Lyle Reams) because fast forward to 2017 and together they filed to open a business. ... According to the formation docs, the business that they filed is called Desert Spirit Tech, LLC.

verification.notes: Arizona Corporation Commission articles and the current entity index identify Desert Spirit Tek LLC, its 2017 formation, and members Lorin Frantzve, Lawrence Guinta, Lyle Reams, and Shelly Reams. This matches the transcript claim, allowing for the filing spelling Lorin.

sources.title: Arizona Corporation Commission — Desert Spirit Tek Articles of Organization
sources.relevance: Primary corporate filing for the 2017 LLC and its organizers and members.
